rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Differentiability at a point:** f is differentiable at x=a if f'(a) exists, i.e., lim(h→0) [f(a+h)-f(a)]/h exists.  ·  **Differentiable implies continuous:** If f is differentiable at a, then f is continuous at a.  ·  **Continuous does not imply differentiable:** |x| is continuous at x=0 but not differentiable.
